assets.name: 迫降营地
assets.subtitle: 在陌生世界醒来
assets.scene: A low windswept ochre basalt plain at first dawn, a shallow impact scar leading to the player's small scorched escape pod, its hatch blown open beside a makeshift expedition camp. Human-scale foreground: a deployed medical kit, a folded thermal blanket, a still-working tiny receiver and one green battery lamp, all protected behind a battered armor plate. In the middle distance a compact repair gantry shelters a grounded 9-meter ivory/navy/crimson humanoid AEGIS mech, tiny relative to landscape, naturally supported by landing feet and scaffolds. Beyond it rises the formidable HELIOS ground hangar with one intact amber-lit entrance and a broken crane. Six early survey beacons are hinted as tiny distinct poles across the plain, linked by dusty vehicle tracks; a fractured signal dish tilts at the horizon. The pale giant and thin rings appear near the low sun. Amber dawn, terracotta dust, deep muted blue shadows, very clear visibility. Camera wide low hillside overlooking camp. Emotional arc: vulnerable beginning, enough shelter to keep going. Damage is recent crash abrasion and a few disabled machines, not a flattened city.

assets.name: 矿区前哨
assets.subtitle: 停在半途的矿车
assets.scene: An immense blue-crystal open-cast mine at stark late morning. Camera from an elevated conveyor transfer deck, showing terraced mineral benches descending diagonally through a vast slate and cobalt valley. Clusters of translucent natural blue mineral emerge from cut rock faces, beautiful but with restrained physical reflections, not giant magic crystals. A colossal bucket excavator stands stalled halfway across one bench. Abandoned ore trains all point toward the same sheltered underground transport entrance. A deep refinery with cylindrical separators and cooling towers sits on the far terrace; one conveyor has collapsed from a failed support, but adjacent maintenance paths remain intact. A fine chain of small emerald evacuation lamps shows the improvised pedestrian route around that broken conveyor. Foreground evidence: a miner's helmet and an oxygen cylinder left on a rusted railing, a lunch container not taken. Distant ringed gas giant small and partially veiled by high white cloud. Steel blue, mineral grey, rust copper, harsh readable sunlight and dusty depth. Prioritize specific industrial engineering and believable layered mine geology. The mine was deliberately stopped and evacuated; do not burn every structure.

assets.name: 遗迹营地
assets.subtitle: 比人类更古老的家
assets.scene: A pale salt-and-stone high plateau containing the monumental ruins of a prehuman civilization. A gigantic incomplete ring arch frames distant stepped terraces and dry ancient water channels; a fallen curved segment lies half buried where its broken supports logically meet the ground. Fine wind erosion, exposed smooth metal under weathered pale stone, thin black mineral seams, empty colonnades and immense worn stairs. Recent human archaeology tents and a compact modular camp cling to the near edge, dwarfed by the ruins. Foreground beside a camp canopy: a carefully wrapped recovered circular artifact, a small field camera and paired empty folding stools, no legible writing. A short row of discreet green battery beacons marks the human route through the old monumental staircase. No people visible. The sky is softly overcast with a narrow warm sunbreak; a faint ring segment barely visible behind cloud, not a giant dominant planet. Chalk, faded gold, dusty lavender and charcoal. Camera slightly elevated from the archaeology camp, deep one-point perspective toward the monumental arch. The destruction is ancient and eroded rather than freshly blasted. Make it feel like encountering somebody else's lost home.

assets.name: 峡谷营地
assets.subtitle: 空床与暖水
assets.scene: An evacuated human residential district sheltered inside a lush narrow canyon, distinct from barren layered K-09. Spring-fed channels and remnants of cultivated greenery soften the dark vertical walls. Homes and workshops are built on staggered terraces joined by hanging footbridges; an immense cylindrical colony habitat with a cracked glazed greenhouse roof is the landmark. The main bridge was cut by a rockfall; a visibly repaired side footbridge carries a thin line of small green evacuation lamps toward a tunnel at the valley's end. Foreground is the threshold of an empty school: a child's tiny chair, a hand-knit scarf on a rail, seedling trays still receiving water through a maintenance tube; use no readable drawings or text. A few warm lamps still glow in otherwise empty apartments, a pale curtain lifts in the breeze. Gentle rain has just passed, reflective paving and dripping leaves, soft diffused afternoon light, warm amber interiors against rich wet green-grey rock. Only a narrow glimpse of the sky and ring high above. Emotional intention: intimate ordinary life left behind, a believable home for families, not generic wreckage. No crowds, no robots, no corpses.

assets.name: 盆地中继
assets.subtitle: 九境静默的中心
assets.scene: A vast broad sunken basin with a distinctive circular rim of dark rock, viewed at violet-blue twilight from a high access-road bend. At its center stand the remains of the main orbital relay: a tall truncated antenna shaft with its enormous upper lattice lying collapsed diagonally over a service yard, clearly matching a precision strike aftermath rather than random explosions. Local white-black melted armor and radial scorch marks at the broken junction; nearby buildings and underground data vault entrances mostly intact. An orderly array of parabolic dishes around the tower face different directions; their status lights are dark. A few independently powered emerald-green road lamps trace a long winding road down from camera, around the damaged area, to one low amber-lit maintenance doorway. On the foreground roadside is an unmanned operations shelter with a mug, a closed maintenance case and a manually disconnected high-voltage cable. No active beam or fireball; small dissipating haze only. Pale ringed planet large above the basin, its ring reflected faintly in isolated rain pools. Muted violet, ink blue, chalk-white wreckage and sparse green/amber light. Evoke a whole continent choosing silence.

assets.name: 山洞前哨
assets.subtitle: 岩壁后的敲击
assets.scene: A spectacular enormous natural basalt cave threshold opening into a connected underground lake and columnar-stone halls. Camera from just inside the cave's high mouth, looking inward and across the lake, with a strip of cold exterior daylight behind and above the near ledge. Six-sided basalt columns form organically fractured walls, dark clear water mirrors the immense ceiling; a few restrained blue mineral veins appear at depth. The recognizable human landmark is a robust cliff-mounted lift station with old rails and a parked evacuation carriage, extending into a modest abandoned miners' outpost on the water's edge. Fallen roof blocks have broken the broad cargo causeway, while a narrower repaired catwalk winds around it. Small green evacuation lamps reflect like a necklace in the water, guiding toward a distant amber shelter, not coating the cavern in neon. Foreground: two old boots drying beside a folded blanket and an empty kettle, evidence of a recent pause. Cavern scale readable through handrails, rope anchors and transport dimensions. Cool black basalt, silver water, deep mineral turquoise and sparse warm habitation. A quieter inviting underground frontier, distinct from the threatening deep mine. No giant robot, no giant castle inside the cave.

assets.name: 深井前哨
assets.subtitle: 不该打开的第二道门
assets.scene: A terrifying colossal sinkhole and deep extraction shaft in a desolate red-black badlands plateau, viewed obliquely downward from its ruined rim. Spiral mining roads and anchored drill platforms descend thousands of meters into atmospheric depth. At the bottom visible through a break in steam is a vast exposed ancient seamless metal surface, with a narrow breached seam emitting faint warm crimson geological light; immense biological-mechanical root-like structures disappear beneath it. The human landmark is a heavy cantilevered drilling gantry partly collapsed into the pit, with a few tension cables still holding a torn lift cage. Fresh cliff subsidence and fallen machines show why the route is dangerous. At the near edge, a sealed shelter and robust safety barriers end an independently powered trail of tiny green guidance lamps; beyond that point sparse red hazard lamps mark the prohibited descent. A gigantic indistinct guardian silhouette far across the inner wall gives scale without becoming the main subject. Foreground a dropped miner's recorder attached to a tool belt, no text or gore. Iron red, coal black, smoky silver, hard late-day side light, weather front and very small partial gas giant in sky. This is the dangerous deep region, no inviting green forest or active battle.

assets.name: 群峰观测站
assets.subtitle: 星环另一面的回应
assets.scene: A remote deep-space observatory spanning jagged glacial mountains, magnificent crisp night just before dawn. Three massive carefully engineered telescope dishes and a slit-dome optical observatory stand on different snow-dusted peaks, linked by exposed service bridges and a cable railway. One dish has buckled under a local ice avalanche; the other two remain deliberately oriented toward a narrow opening in the giant planet's rings. The ringed gas giant is seen with dramatic astronomical clarity, pale pearl bands and thin sharp rings dominating the upper sky, scattered restrained stars, no colorful fantasy nebula. From the foreground heated maintenance hut, a string of tiny emerald-green battery lamps follows a switchback route through snow toward the surviving dome; wind piles snow around their bases. A packed travel bag, insulated thermos and one empty chair face the observation window inside the foreground shelter; warm amber light shows somebody had been listening here. Distant frozen valley filled with low cloud, immense cold depth. Pearl white, deep navy, silver ice, gentle peach dawn on the farthest peaks. No city skyline, no battle, no robot foreground. Lonely vigilance and an unresolved possibility of a reply.

assets.name: K–09 层岩峡谷
assets.subtitle: 跟着第一盏灯走
assets.scene: The welcoming but immense K-09 layered canyon, unmistakable sculpted sedimentary geology in rust orange, warm tan and dark mineral ribbons, winding traversable sandy floor, eroded natural arches and several overhangs. Camera from a gentle low ridge near the beginning of a broad ground route. On the left a small field repair shelter and tall ground-mech hangar sit naturally against the rock, one warm service bay still powered; on the right the route bends beneath a vast natural arch into a continuous cave mouth. A logical rockfall has blocked the former straight track and the surviving route gently curves around it, marked by physically grounded small emerald-green maintenance lights and simple railings. Foreground one well-maintained lamp beside a patched independent battery box, old glove and footprints in the dust. A small solitary 9-meter ivory/navy/crimson AEGIS humanoid exploration mech with long articulated legs, compact twin thrusters and swept antennae stands far enough away to establish scale, head turned toward the lights, no raised weapon. Beyond the canyon's opening, a pale ringed giant spans a quiet copper-pink early evening sky. Soft golden side light, detailed strata, subtle airborne dust, calm hopeful mood. The place where a long expedition begins; not an overbuilt city, not snow, not a bottomless sinister mine.
